text:
anya: Heads-up: cost-mapper v2 landed to canary preview plane and the preview ledger is showing unexpected negative promo adjustments for a small set of tenants. Repro steps below.

mike: I saw spikes in preview rows too. Do you have a sample tenant id?

anya: tenant: tc-39f2; reproducer: run `./tools/preview_generate --tenant tc-39f2 --window 1h` yields -$1.50 promotion line under 'preview_ledger'

ingest-bot: Shadow-ingest finished for trace id=abc123, route_hint=rtb-legacy, sampler=0.02

sam: Looks like cost-mapper v2 normalizes route_hint -> canonical_route by stripping the top-level tag. That interacts badly with sampling: multiple sampled events now collapse to the same canonical key which then picks up promo credit dedupe across tenants.

lisa: :eyes: That's bad — product analytics relies on preview ledger to estimate promo utilization. Is this limited to preview plane or also production ingress?

anya: Only preview so far (canary). But sampling bias could show up in production if we flip flag. Root cause seems to be twofold: route_key collapse + sampling weight inversion in the aggregator.

mike: Can you paste the log snippet from the aggregator?

anya: Here —
```
2026-02-11T14:07:12Z INFO aggregator[tid=abc123] canonical_route=rtb legacy -> rtb
2026-02-11T14:07:12Z INFO sampler weight=0.02 recorded_count=5 mapped_count=1
```

sam: Ok that shows 5 sampled events mapped to 1 canonical row. Promo dedupe logic currently triggers when mapped_count>1 -> apply promo once. So promo applied once but then back-propagated as a negative adjustment later due to ledger reconciliation.

mike: Proposed quick mitigations: a) revert canonicalization for preview, b) bump sampler to 0.2 for canary to reduce collapse, c) add telemetry metric `mapped_sample_collapse_rate` to console.

lisa: Adding telemetry is must. Also request: hide preview ledger promo adjustments from non-admin view until fixed — customers might get confused by preview charges.

anya: Agree. I'll open a small PR to gate canonicalization under `feature.preview_cost_mapper_v2` flag and add the metric. Can someone own console gating?

sam: I can do gating — UI change is trivial: filter out lines with tag `preview_adjustment=true` for roles != admin. Will send patch.

ingest-bot: Canary rollback scheduled by deploy-bot at 14:20 UTC if no ACK.

mike: :thumbsup: Thanks. Also let's add a one-off backfill to correct preview ledger for any tenants affected in the last 24h.

anya: I'll coordinate backfill script with eng-infra. Checklist: doc the regression, surface metric, gating patch, optional revert. ETA EOD.

lisa: Assigning to sprint: GA-187. Will update analytics dashboard doc.

sam: Quick note — when changing sampler weights, update the `sampling-policy.json` in repo so future rollouts don't surprise.

mike: Thanks folks. If anyone finds other negative adjustments, ping #incidents. Closing thread once revert or patch is live.
